# Stilletos Decor & Catering

> Stilletos Decor & Catering is an event styling, decor and equipment-hire business based in Chaneng, Rustenburg, North West, South Africa. It trades under two brands: Stilletos Decor (black-and-gold event decor, table styling, chair and furniture hire for adult events) and Stilletos Kids (themed kids' party packages, jumping castles and kids furniture hire). Quotes are requested via WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Official website: https://stilletosdecor.vercel.app/
- Business name: Stilletos Decor & Catering (also written "Stilletos Decor" and "Stilletos Kids"). The spelling is "Stilletos" with two l's; it is not the shoe "stilettos".
- Tagline: Crafting Luxuries, Creating Memories
- Established: 2018 (as stated on the website)
- Address: 397 Matshelapata, Chaneng, Rustenburg, 0310, South Africa
- Coordinates: -25.4118433, 27.126436
- Phone / WhatsApp: 067 659 5756 (+27676595756)
- Email: cafenetwork1@gmail.com
- Service area: Rustenburg and surrounding communities in the North West province
- Currency: South African Rand (ZAR)
- How to book: the website is a catalogue with a quote cart. Visitors add items, then send the list to the business on WhatsApp. There is no online checkout or online payment.
- Pricing note: prices below are as listed on the website. Kids package prices exclude transport. Confirm availability, transport and final pricing with the business before relying on them.

## Stilletos Decor: adult event services
- Full Event Decor & Design: From blueprint design to on-site execution, we conceptualize and build gorgeous, high-contrast black-and-gold themed atmospheres for milestones and high-end events.
  - Tailored color palette alignment (sleek black, matte gold, crystal accents)
  - Exclusive backdrops, floral structures, and custom printed photobooth walls
  - Full installation, staging, and breakdown
- Tailored Table Styling: The table is your canvas. We design cohesive, jaw-dropping tablescapes featuring ribbed amber glassware, gold beaded charger plates, custom black napkins, and breathtaking floral displays.
  - Layered high-end dinnerware curation
  - Unique amber and ribbed crystal glassware pairs
  - Custom linen rentals including premium velvet or high-thread cotton napkins
  - Floral centerpieces combined with elegant tapered gold candle holders
- Premium Equipment Hire: An exclusive collection of pristine tablescape assets, gorgeous seating, structures, and service-ready items for food service setup.
  - Phoenix chairs and velvet throne statement pieces
  - Premium plates, glass pairs, gold cutlery, and tableware sets
  - Custom backdrops, balloon rings, and stage platform elements
  - Professional cleaning and quality-inspected item delivery

- Black CrossBack Chair: R35
- Double Seater Couch: R550 (also available: Blue, Green, Black, Nude)

## Stilletos Kids: party packages
- Glam Package (Premium Whimsical Wonderland): A premium wonderland experience featuring our signature white flooring, cabana tent, specialized butterfly wooden chairs, and candy cart.
  - Prices: 10 kids R7 500; 15 kids R8 500; 20 kids R9 500 (excl. transport)
  - Includes: Cabana Tent & White Flooring; Balloon Entrance Arch; Multi Backdrops Panels; Premium Main Birthday Chair; Premium Kids Chairs (Wood/Butterfly style); Full Theme Party Packs with custom goodies; Printing - Full Backdrop Sticker + Stickers 2x2; Themed Party Pack Stand; Beautiful Mini Candy Cart; White Jumping Castle (3x3m); Elegant Plates, Glasses & Cutlery matching the theme; Custom Creative Centerpieces; Custom Branded Bottled Water; Stunning Cake Table setup; Delectable Milkshakes
- Standard Package (Vibrant Classic Party Fun): A colorful fun-filled classic package containing a custom 3x3 jumping castle, artificial lawn grass carpet, mini throne/table, and beautiful theme decorations.
  - Prices: 10 kids R4 000; 15 kids R5 000; 20 kids R6 000 (excl. transport)
  - Includes: Sturdy Cabana Tent shelter; 3 Printed/Styled Backdrop screens; Mini Main Birthday Chair; Themed Kids Chairs (Tiffany or Wimbledon); Cute Theme Party Packs; Custom Printed Stickers x2; Multi-color 3x3m Jumping Castle included; Party Pack Display Stand; Colorful Plates, Glasses & Cutlery (high quality plastic/paper); Themed Table Centerpiece decoration; Themed Bottled Water; Classic Cake Table display; Green Artificial Carpet/Lawn
- Add-ons: Bubble House R2 000; Fresh Flowers R1 000
